limitations: Recorded evidence only. Missing observations do not prove non-use or success; current configuration does not establish historical settings.

Error rates use resolved calls as the denominator; unresolved calls are not failures. Program outcomes count only when the program was the sole parsed program of a shell call, and conventional "no match" exits (rg/grep/diff/test exit 1) are reported separately.
Result sizes are recorded payload bytes whose envelopes differ by provider; they are not token counts. Durations can include permission prompts and queueing.
Finding associations with session endings are correlations over this cohort, not causes. Issue groups and findings overlap and are not unique incidents.

Listings compare names a host listed (skill listings, deferred tool announcements) in root sessions with recorded invocations, skill-file reads and calls anywhere in the cohort; a child thread's copy of a listing is not counted again. A listed name without a recorded use is not proof of non-use. Command time sums recorded shell durations per provider; code-mode cells are excluded and concurrent commands overlap.

Structure learnings use recorded input field names and nested field paths (`field.key`, `field[].key`, two levels below a top-level field, first 20 array items); deeper names are not visible. Pooled parameter, path, format, error-shape and repetition counts are canonical in Aggregate.toolEvidence.

runs.description: 2 of 36 components with at least 30 attributed outcomes fail in ≥ 25% of them across 90 analyzed sessions.
limitations: Folded recorded evidence across sessions; missing observations do not prove success or non-use. Thresholds are review policy, not vendor limits.
Components ranked below the learnings cap (0 omitted) are not checked.
Program outcomes count only calls where the program was the sole parsed program; "no match" exits, user rejections and interruptions are excluded.

runs.description: 5 error groups (tool × class × exit code) recur in ≥ 5 sessions across 90 analyzed sessions.
limitations: Folded recorded evidence across sessions; missing observations do not prove success or non-use. Thresholds are review policy, not vendor limits.
User rejections, interruptions and process exit statuses are excluded; groups overlap with per-session findings and are not unique incidents.

runs.description: 1 tools return ≥ 20 KiB at p95 and carry ≥ 5% of all measured tool result bytes.
limitations: Folded recorded evidence across sessions; missing observations do not prove success or non-use. Thresholds are review policy, not vendor limits.

runs.description: 3 rules or detectors fire in most eligible sessions across 90 analyzed sessions.
limitations: Folded recorded evidence across sessions; missing observations do not prove success or non-use. Thresholds are review policy, not vendor limits.
Coverage-style findings (for example, a provider that records no hook runs) fire by design and are listed for review, not removal.
Detector rates require supplied detector reports.

runs.description: 3 tools have input fields or nested field paths that change their recorded failure rate (|z| ≥ 3, ≥ 15 points) over pooled tool evidence.
limitations: Folded recorded evidence across sessions; missing observations do not prove success or non-use. Thresholds are review policy, not vendor limits.
Reads the canonical pooled Aggregate.toolEvidence. An association between a field and failures is not a cause; the field may mark a harder request.

Nested paths (`field.key`, `field[].key`) reach two levels below a top-level field and count a call once however many array items carry the path. Tools with partial shape or path coverage, capped key or path lists, and tools past the pooled row cap are skipped for that comparison; calls with omitted names or sampled arrays (`partialParamPathCalls`) can undercount a path.

runs.description: 5 tools are repeatedly retried with a different input key set right after a failure.
limitations: Folded recorded evidence across sessions; missing observations do not prove success or non-use. Thresholds are review policy, not vendor limits.
Only the same actor's next call is compared, using top-level field names and nested field paths (two levels below a top-level field).

runs.description: 1 tools return much larger results when called without a bounding field.
limitations: Folded recorded evidence across sessions; missing observations do not prove success or non-use. Thresholds are review policy, not vendor limits.
Bounding fields are recognized by name (limit, max…, page…, line and character ranges); a field with another name is not recognized.

runs.description: 0 of 7 tools with enough scanned results repeat lines or line prefixes in ≥ 20% of their result bytes.
limitations: Folded recorded evidence across sessions; missing observations do not prove success or non-use. Thresholds are review policy, not vendor limits.
Reads the canonical pooled Aggregate.toolEvidence; tools past its row cap are not checked.
Duplicate-line and prefix estimates can overlap; the redundant share is an upper estimate of removable bytes, not a token count.

runs.description: 35 skills were listed in ≥ 10 sessions and never invoked or read across 90 analyzed sessions.
limitations: Folded recorded evidence across sessions; missing observations do not prove success or non-use. Thresholds are review policy, not vendor limits.
Listed names come from recorded skill listings, including host-provided skills. Only root sessions count as listings; a use in any thread, child threads included, counts as use.

Origins come from current local declarations: a skill declared elsewhere, or earlier, reads as not declared. Client usage counters (~/.claude.json) can count uses in sessions no longer on disk, so they may disagree with this cohort.

runs.description: 16 deferred tools were listed in ≥ 10 sessions and never called across 90 analyzed sessions.
limitations: Folded recorded evidence across sessions; missing observations do not prove success or non-use. Thresholds are review policy, not vendor limits.

limitations: Folded recorded evidence across sessions; missing observations do not prove success or non-use. Thresholds are review policy, not vendor limits.
Recorded command durations can include waiting on user approval, and concurrent commands overlap; summed command time is not wall-clock time. Code-mode cells are excluded.
